royalty_free.name: TikTok Commercial Music Library (CML)
royalty_free.license: Pre-cleared library of about 1M tracks that businesses can use free of charge in organic posts, ads and branded content, on TikTok only. CML user terms: 'Commercial Uses outside of TikTok are not permitted'; sounds can't be distributed or performed separately from the videos; TikTok may mute or remove videos if it loses rights to a track; Premium tracks can carry an ad-inventory fee; Business users indemnify TikTok for misuse.
royalty_free.api: yes, via the TikTok API for Business with a Business-account token. GET https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/discovery/cml/trending_list/?business_id=..&genre=ALL|POP|LO-FI|..&country_code=US&date_range=1DAY|7DAY|30DAY|90DAY returns up to 100 popular CML tracks (commercial_music_id, name, artist, duration, preview_url that never expires, rank_position, 30-day trending_history, song_clip_id). Pass song_clip_id as music_sound_info.music_sound_id to POST /open_api/v1.3/business/video/publish/ (with music_sound_volume 0-100, music_sound_start/music_sound_end in ms, video_original_sound_volume 0-100) or /business/photo/publish/ (which also takes auto_add_music). TikTok mixes the track server-side; you never download it.
royalty_free.notes: The only fully automated, fully licensed way to put a trending-chart track on an auto-posted TikTok. Limits: 6 posts/min and 15/day per account (each for video and photo). The API exposes only the top-100 popular list; full CML search is in-app only. Not reusable on Reels or Shorts. The public Creative Center 'Songs' chart (with its 'approved for business use' filter) no longer loads logged-out; the URL redirects to Hashtags (checked 2026-10-15).

royalty_free.name: Meta Sound Collection / Instagram business-available audio
royalty_free.license: Royalty-free music and SFX from Meta, cleared for content on Facebook and Instagram, including business pages (secondary sources put the size at roughly 14K items). Meta's Music Guidelines say: 'Use of music for commercial or non-personal purposes in particular is prohibited' unless you've obtained appropriate licenses; unlicensed music can be blocked, muted or removed. Off-Meta use isn't covered (verify the Sound Collection terms).
royalty_free.api: partial. Meta's IG User Media reference only documents audio_name (a one-time rename of a Reel's original audio) and says music tagging is only available for original audio. Vendors (Ayrshare 'audioConfiguration', bundle.social 'musicSoundInfo') describe an Instagram Audio API, available only with Facebook Login, that attaches Meta-authorized tracks (Sound Collection music plus some original sounds) by audio_id to Reels. It isn't in Meta's public reference, so treat it as unverified. Downloads from the Sound Collection are manual.
royalty_free.notes: Instagram business accounts see a restricted library in-app. For API-published Reels, check copyright_check_status on the container before calling media_publish.

royalty_free.name: YouTube Audio Library
royalty_free.license: Free. Audio Library music and SFX won't get Content ID claims on YouTube and can be monetized in YPP. Some tracks require credit in the video description (CC BY); filter on 'Attribution not required' to avoid that. The help page doesn't address use outside YouTube; YouTube only vouches for safety on YouTube.
royalty_free.api: no. Manual MP3 download in YouTube Studio; no bulk or API access.
royalty_free.notes: The safest bed for Shorts. For TikTok or Instagram, prefer its CC BY tracks (portable with credit) or check the Studio terms.

royalty_free.name: Pixabay Music
royalty_free.license: Pixabay Content License: free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution. Prohibited: selling or distributing content on a 'Standalone' basis (including as an audio file), trademark use, and misleading use. Pixabay doesn't warrant third-party consents. The terms don't mention Content ID.
royalty_free.api: no for audio. The official API covers images and videos only (100 requests/60 s, 24 h caching required), and the ToS bans scraping and automated collection.
royalty_free.notes: Good for baked-in beds. Keep download records in case a third party files a Content ID claim; the terms say to stop using content that's under a claim.

royalty_free.name: Uppbeat
royalty_free.license: Free account: 3 downloads for individual use on your own channels. Paid, billed yearly: Essentials $6.99/mo and Creator $8.99/mo (individuals publishing on their own channels); Pro $14.99/mo (freelancers, client projects, commercial digital use); Business $34.99/mo, yearly only (companies and teams). Plans include music and SFX plus YouTube channel safelisting (1-10 channels). Custom licensing for broadcast.
royalty_free.api: no public API found (none on the pricing page); downloads are manual.
royalty_free.notes: A brand or company account promoting an app needs Pro or Business for 'commercial digital use'.

royalty_free.name: Free Music Archive (FMA)
royalty_free.license: Per-track Creative Commons. Commercial use OK: CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0. CC BY-ND can't be synced to video. NC variants forbid advertising and promotion. FMA doesn't license music commercially itself and points to Tribe of Noise PRO for 'all rights included' licensing.
royalty_free.api: no current public API documented. The research 'FMA dataset' exists, but licenses vary per track.
royalty_free.notes: Store license and credit per track, and filter out NC and ND for app promos.

royalty_free.name: Incompetech (Kevin MacLeod)
royalty_free.license: CC BY 4.0 free with credit. Required credit format: 'Title Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) / Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 / https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/'. A paid Standard License removes the attribution requirement (price isn't listed on the license page). YouTube monetization is explicitly allowed.
royalty_free.api: no API; per-track downloads (an ISRC list is published).
royalty_free.notes: Hosts TikTok-famous evergreens 'Monkeys Spinning Monkeys' (27.8M TikTok videos) and 'Sneaky Snitch'. These are recognizable sounds you can legally bake in anywhere; put the credit in the caption.

royalty_free.name: Mixkit (music)
royalty_free.license: Mixkit Stock Music Free License (Envato): free, including commercial projects, with no attribution. The exact clauses sit behind 'View License' on mixkit.co/license; we couldn't read them this session, so verify the standalone-redistribution and Content ID clauses.
royalty_free.api: no public API; downloads are manual.

royalty_free.name: Jamendo (Jamendo Music + Jamendo Licensing)
royalty_free.license: Tracks carry various CC licenses. Commercial sync (ads, promos) needs a paid license through Jamendo Licensing (https://licensing.jamendo.com).
royalty_free.api: yes: Jamendo API v3 (client_id; track search by tags, with stream and download URLs). Free non-commercial apps get up to 35K requests/month; commercial apps need an agreement.
royalty_free.notes: Good for discovery. Buy licenses for any track used commercially.

royalty_free.name: Openverse (CC audio aggregator)
royalty_free.license: Aggregates CC and public-domain audio (Freesound, Jamendo, Wikimedia). Each result includes license, license_version and a ready-made attribution string.
royalty_free.api: yes: GET https://api.openverse.org/v1/audio/?q=whoosh&license_type=commercial (also category=music|sound_effect). Anonymous limits are 20/min burst and 200/day (from response headers); a registered app gets more.
royalty_free.notes: A quick way to find CC0 SFX. Store the attribution string with every asset.

royalty_free.name: Epidemic Sound API
royalty_free.license: Free API plan: prototyping only, no commercial license, up to 50 downloads. Scale plan (custom pricing by download volume): commercial license with sublicensing to end users, 'use anywhere: social, websites, ads'; safelisting is a paid add-on. Enterprise (over 1,000 downloads/month): custom license and full safelisting.
royalty_free.api: yes: about 55K tracks and 250K+ SFX, with semantic search, Soundmatch (recommendations from video frames), Find similar, and Highlights (the best segment of a track for short-form).
royalty_free.notes: The strongest licensed-library API for a product like Shipreel. Highlights solves 'pick the 15-second hook'.

royalty_free.name: Musopen and other public-domain classical recordings
royalty_free.license: Public-domain compositions (Chopin, Satie, Debussy) in recordings released as public domain or CC by Musopen. Verify each recording; the composition being PD doesn't make every recording PD.
royalty_free.notes: A bake-in-safe way to get the evergreen 'Chopin Nocturne' or 'Gymnopédie' feel. Not verified this session.

royalty_free.name: Soundstripe
royalty_free.license: Subscription license covering social and commercial use on its business tiers (verify).
royalty_free.api: advertises a partner API (not verified this session).
royalty_free.notes: An alternative to Epidemic for an embedded catalog. Confirm the API terms before building on it.

ai_generation.name: ElevenLabs Eleven Music
ai_generation.endpoint: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/music (JSON: prompt OR composition_plan; music_length_ms 3,000-600,000; model_id music_v1 | music_v2 | music_v2_5; force_instrumental; seed only with composition_plan; finetune_id; sign_with_c2pa; output_format query). Returns audio bytes, with the song id in the response headers for inpainting or conditioning.
ai_generation.pricing: API: $0.15 per minute of music on every tier (pricing page, Oct 2026). Plan bundles include e.g. Starter 40 min, Creator 147 min, Pro 660 min; finetunes $1.50.
ai_generation.license: Eleven Music terms: commercial use on Free through Business, except film, TV, radio and 'Studio Games' (Enterprise Music removes that exclusion). Free needs attribution ('Created in collaboration with ElevenLabs'); Starter and up don't. Streaming-service distribution requires Creator or higher. Prompts can't name real artists, songs or labels or quote substantial lyrics. Resellers and 'pure-play music AI' companies must co-brand, and reselling music libraries is prohibited without written approval. Eligibility: Free to Pro is individuals only; Scale under 10 employees; Business under 50.
ai_generation.notes: The best quality and licensing combination for custom beds and jingles. Have users connect their own ElevenLabs key (BYOK) so they are the licensee and Shipreel isn't a reseller. Prompt by genre, mood, BPM and instrumentation, never 'like <song>'.

ai_generation.name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects
ai_generation.endpoint: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/sound-generation (text; duration_seconds 0.5-30; prompt_influence 0-1, default 0.3; loop, v2 only; model_id eleven_text_to_sound_v2; output_format query). Returns MP3.
ai_generation.pricing: Listed at $0.12/min on the API pricing page, which also says SFX are 'billed per generation', so verify. Plan bundles: Free 8, Starter 150, Creator 605, Pro 3,000 generations.
ai_generation.license: Outputs described as royalty-free. Commercial rights follow the plan terms (paid plans; check the free tier).
ai_generation.notes: Generate a branded SFX kit once (whoosh, pop, ding, riser) and cache it locally for a consistent sonic identity at near-zero marginal cost.

ai_generation.name: Stability AI Stable Audio 3.0 / 2.5
ai_generation.endpoint: POST https://api.stability.ai/v2beta/audio/stable-audio/text-to-audio (model=stable-audio-3; duration 1-380 s, default 190; steps 4-8; cfg_scale 1-25; seed). Also /v2beta/audio/stable-audio/audio-to-audio and /inpaint. Stable Audio 2.5: /v2beta/audio/stable-audio-2/text-to-audio, /audio-to-audio, /inpaint. Async results at /v2beta/audio/results/{id}.
ai_generation.pricing: 8 credits ($0.08) per generation for both Stable Audio 3.0 (up to ~6 min) and 2.5 (up to 3 min). 1 credit = $0.01; 25 free credits to start.
ai_generation.license: Stability: as between you and Stability, you own the outputs (subject to law and the AUP), and commercial use is allowed. Self-hosted Core Models fall under the Community License (free under $1M annual revenue; Enterprise license above that).
ai_generation.notes: The cheapest per-track option. Instrumental beds, loops and SFX. Audio-to-audio can restyle a hummed motif into a jingle.

ai_generation.name: Stable Audio Open (self-hosted)
ai_generation.endpoint: Local inference (stable-audio-tools / diffusers). No API cost.
ai_generation.pricing: Free (runs on your own GPU or Mac).
ai_generation.license: Stability AI Community License: free commercial use under $1M annual revenue (verify on the model card).
ai_generation.notes: Short clips (about 47 s, from memory; verify). Best for SFX, textures and loops. Fits a local-first app. Not verified this session.

ai_generation.name: Google Lyria 3 / Lyria 3.5 (Gemini API)
ai_generation.endpoint: Interactions API: POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions (or SDK interactions.create) with model lyria-3-clip-preview (30 s clips) or lyria-3.5 (full songs, about a couple of minutes). 44.1 kHz stereo; MP3 by default, WAV for 3.5 via response_format.
ai_generation.pricing: Lyria 3 Clip: $0.04 per song; Lyria 3.5 and Lyria 3 Pro preview: $0.08 per song. No free tier.
ai_generation.license: Gemini API terms (paid tier). Every output carries a SynthID audio watermark, and prompts naming specific artists or copyrighted lyrics are blocked. Check the Gemini API Additional Terms for ownership and commercial clauses.
ai_generation.notes: Cheap and high quality for 30-second beds. Lyria RealTime (streaming, interactive) also exists but isn't priced on that page. Lyria 2 and 3 are also on Vertex AI.

ai_generation.name: MiniMax Music 2.0 (via fal.ai)
ai_generation.endpoint: fal queue API, e.g. POST https://queue.fal.run/fal-ai/minimax-music/v2 (style prompt 10-300 chars plus lyrics 10-3,000 chars with [Verse]/[Chorus] tags). Returns MP3.
ai_generation.license: 'Commercial use via fal partnership' per the model page. Read the fal and MiniMax terms.
ai_generation.notes: The cheapest option for full songs with vocals: brand jingles and 'song about my app' gimmicks.

ai_generation.name: Suno
ai_generation.endpoint: No official public API (the terms mention none). Third-party 'Suno API' wrappers depend on automated access that the terms prohibit (robots, scraping, means not intentionally provided).
ai_generation.pricing: Consumer subscriptions (Free, Pro, Premier); see suno.com.
ai_generation.license: Terms revised 2026-08-10, effective 2026-09-03. Free/Basic: personal, non-commercial only. Pro/Premier: Suno assigns its rights in outputs, but commercial use applies only to permitted downloads within your tier's monthly allowance. Remixes are non-commercial. Suno may embed watermarks or metadata showing tier and download status.
ai_generation.notes: Can't be automated in Shipreel. A Pro user can generate manually and import the downloaded file.

ai_generation.name: Udio
ai_generation.license: UNCERTAIN as of 2026-10. After its late-2025 settlements with the major labels, Udio disabled downloads and announced a licensed 'walled garden' platform. Assume outputs can't be exported for commercial social posts unless current terms say otherwise.
ai_generation.notes: Treat as unavailable for an auto-posting pipeline, and re-check the current terms.

ai_generation.name: Mubert API
ai_generation.endpoint: REST API: generate tracks from text, image, tags, BPM, mood or activity (15 s to 25 min); WebRTC live streams; a library of about 12K pre-generated tracks.
ai_generation.pricing: Trial $49/mo (100 generations and streaming minutes); Startup $199/mo (5,000); Startup+ $499/mo (30,000); custom tiers.
ai_generation.license: 'Royalty-free', 'DMCA-free', 'cleared for monetization'; sub-licensing listed on plans. The site footer limits listening on Mubert's own domains to personal use, so confirm the API license.

ai_generation.name: Beatoven.ai (maestro API)
ai_generation.endpoint: Text-prompt music composition plus SFX generation (API key from the dashboard; see their API docs).
ai_generation.pricing: Not published on the API page.
ai_generation.license: Output 'always cleared for commercial use'. Fairly Trained certified.

ai_generation.name: SOUNDRAW API
ai_generation.endpoint: Generation by genre, mood and theme, with stems and customization (docs after sign-up).
ai_generation.pricing: API Starter $29.99/mo (up to 100 songs/mo, companies of 3 or fewer); API Pro $300/mo (up to 1,000 songs/mo, 6-month minimum); custom plans.
ai_generation.license: 'Safe for commercial use', 'no copyright strikes'. Each plan links its own license document.

ai_generation.name: Loudly Music API
ai_generation.endpoint: Parameter generator (genre, energy, duration), text-to-music, a library of about 3.5K tracks, stems, WAV output.
ai_generation.pricing: Custom and volume-based; a free track allowance on signup.
ai_generation.license: Royalty-free, worldwide, perpetual, for 'any digital platform'. Confirm social-media specifics.

ai_generation.name: ACE-Step v1.5 (open source)
ai_generation.endpoint: Local inference (Python 3.10+, about 8 GB VRAM; runs on Apple Silicon, where an M2 Max takes about 26 s per minute of audio).
ai_generation.license: Apache-2.0 per the repo. Weights terms aren't stated separately, so verify.
ai_generation.notes: v1.5 released 2026-01-28. Up to about 4-minute songs with lyrics. Fits Shipreel's local-first design as an offline fallback.

ai_generation.name: Meta MusicGen / AudioGen (AudioCraft)
ai_generation.license: Code is MIT; model weights are CC-BY-NC 4.0, which means non-commercial.

sfx_sources.name: Freesound
sfx_sources.license: Per sound: CC0, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0 (filter to CC0 for no friction; avoid NC).
sfx_sources.notes: API: a token for search and previews, OAuth2 for original downloads. Limits are 60 req/min and 2,000/day (downloads 30/min, 500/day). The API terms say commercial use of the API is negotiated case by case with UPF, and you can't make full copies of the database. For a commercial app, curate a CC0 kit offline or have users fetch sounds with their own accounts.

sfx_sources.name: Openverse (sound_effect category)
sfx_sources.license: Per item (mostly CC0 and CC BY from Freesound and Wikimedia), with an attribution string included.
sfx_sources.notes: Anonymous limits: 20/min, 200/day. Handy for building a starter palette.

sfx_sources.name: Pixabay Sound Effects
sfx_sources.license: Pixabay Content License: commercial use, no attribution, no standalone redistribution.
sfx_sources.notes: No audio API, and scraping is banned. Download manually.

sfx_sources.name: Mixkit Sound Effects
sfx_sources.license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License: commercial use with no attribution (verify the exact clauses on mixkit.co/license).

sfx_sources.name: ZapSplat
sfx_sources.license: Free Standard license requires attribution; Premium removes attribution and adds WAV and more downloads. Our page fetch was blocked (403), so verify.

sfx_sources.name: Kenney audio packs (e.g. Interface Sounds)
sfx_sources.notes: 100 UI clicks and button sounds: ideal for tap and click accents in screen recordings, with zero licensing friction.

sfx_sources.name: Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundles
sfx_sources.license: Free, royalty-free, commercial use, no attribution, unlimited projects. You can't redistribute or resell the sounds as SFX, and AI/ML training is prohibited.
sfx_sources.notes: 9-48 GB per year (2015-2024 plus a 2026 page). A professional-grade whoosh, impact and UI library to bundle into curated presets (the presets themselves can't be redistributed as raw SFX).

sfx_sources.name: YouTube Audio Library (SFX)
sfx_sources.license: Free, with no Content ID claims on YouTube. Off-YouTube use isn't addressed.

sfx_sources.name: Uppbeat SFX
sfx_sources.license: Included in paid plans; Pro and Business cover commercial digital use.

sfx_sources.name: Epidemic Sound SFX (API)
sfx_sources.license: Commercial and sublicensable on the Scale and Enterprise API plans.
sfx_sources.notes: 250K+ SFX available through the same API as the music.

sfx_sources.name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects (generated)
sfx_sources.notes: Make bespoke brand SFX (a signature 'ding', the app's 'whoosh').

sfx_sources.name: Stable Audio 2.5/3.0 or Stable Audio Open (generated)
sfx_sources.license: You own the outputs (Stability terms). Open weights are free under the Community License below $1M revenue.
sfx_sources.notes: $0.08 per generation via the API, or free locally.

sfx_sources.name: BBC Sound Effects (avoid for marketing)
sfx_sources.license: RemArc licence: personal, educational and research use only. Commercial use needs a separate licence. From memory; the page couldn't be fetched this session.

sfx_sources.name: Meme soundboards (Myinstants, 101soundboards, etc.)
sfx_sources.license: Unknown provenance. Many clips are ripped from TV, games, films and OS sounds.
sfx_sources.notes: Never bake these into auto-posted promos. Recreate the effect with your own or CC0 material instead (e.g. a deep 808 'boom' in place of the 'vine boom' clip). Also avoid brand sound marks and OS sounds (iPhone tri-tone, Windows startup, Netflix 'ta-dum', Discord ping).
